description: Check whether a bullion product can be held in a US precious-metals IRA under IRC 408(m): the catalog's recorded determination first, otherwise the statutory fineness rules with the American Eagle exception. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).
